reading.lever: Combine HVOF coating deposition with in situ creep testing and high-resolution DIC to capture phase-boundary dynamics under continuous load.
reading.why: This strategy leverages an established coating process with advanced in situ microstructural monitoring to directly test if coherent phase boundaries suppress dislocation climb and mitigate creep.
